correctness.rationale: Liang–Liao Example 6.1 supplies an explicit 5-by-11 generator; independently interpreted the printed omega powers in GF(9)=GF(3)[omega]/(omega²-omega-1), for all four primitive exponents 1,3,5,7. Instead of trusting the supplied exhaustive RREF script, independently derived the r-dimensional subcode-support histograms from the lattice of coordinate zero constraints, with Gaussian-binomial intersection counts and Möbius/inclusion-exclusion over 2^11 coordinate masks. All four choices yield N1={6:28,7:190,8:610,9:1755,10:2780,11:2018}, N2={8:165,9:4510,10:72567,11:528000}, N3={9:55,10:8910,11:596277}, N4={10:11,11:7370}, N5={11:1}. Totals are Gaussian coefficients (7381,605242,605242,7381,1); N1 times eight reproduces the published codeword enumerator. Linear message-map rank five and unique subspaces guarantee exactness; no unchecked extrapolation.
residual_risks: Restricted to the exact displayed EGRL instance, not every NMDS or GRL code. Primitive choices checked as distinct field representations; no abstract equivalence asserted.
